C1492.title: A Survey on Long-Range Attacks for Proof of Stake Protocols
C1492.summary: This survey systematically examines long-range attack scenarios in Proof of Stake protocols, progressing from simple to complex cases to analyze how attackers exploit historical private keys to build alternative chains from the genesis block, attempting to overwrite the canonical chain history.
